params.name: Run the probe
params.tooltip: DEV ONLY. Asks the engine about every combination of the chosen subset once per game load. Builds nothing.

params.name: Subset
params.tooltip: Sweeps: smoke 17, splitter6 432, magic 60, main_cw 216, main 10368, all 10644 combinations. Searches (jobs, about 40 engine calls/s): search_quick 178 (~1 min), search_magic 48, search_tram 318, search_splitter 76 (~4 min), search_radius 6624 (~5-7 min), search_radius_split 2880 (only arm roads with a baked splitter rule), search = all but radius_split (~10-12 min), search_magic2 12 (2-lane Magic satellites, ~3 s), search_magic_sizes 24 (every Magic size floor, 1 and 2 lanes, ~5 s). Phase 5e: p5_all = p5_channel + p5_hamburger + p5_interchange sweeps (1970 combos, ~1-2 min); p5_search = p5_channel_search + p5_hamburger_radius + p5_interchange_search (522 jobs, ~3-5 min). Phase 5f: p5f_all = verification sweep of the tuned channel, 4-lane two-bridge interchange, 2:1 splitter ovals and hamburger (1,416 combos, ~30-60 s); p5f_search = channel slip angle x template for the 81 combos nothing was accepted for, two-bridge alpha (87 jobs, 753 engine calls, ~1 min). Phase 5g: p5g_verify = verification sweep of the 5g channel slip lanes and 4-lane two-bridge rings (468 combos, ~10 s). Highway Interchange (the six per-type entries since Phase 7c2): p7_hx_all = every type x highway x level x Scale (25 / 45 / 80 m loops, 0 / 30 / 80 m diamond terminals) x 3 cross roads x 1969/2020, +60 m ramps, left-hand traffic (696 combos, ~1-2 min); p7_hx_search = terminal gap x clearance x gore run, loop radius 20-30 m at Scale Small (66 jobs, 504 engine calls, ~1 min); p7_verify = the large-highway parclos, highway over road, Scale Small / Medium (150 combos, ~10 s); p7_spot = one real spot (set Position to Camera centre): parclo B4 / A4 / diamond x 7 rotations x 4 proposal contexts, origin shifts, Roundabout Interchange control (~100 calls, ~5-10 s); p7_spot2 = the B4 combo at 0 degrees, origin shifted 0-8 m in 0.5 m steps, contexts none / full (578 calls, ~20-40 s). Phase 7d2: p7_hx_scale = Parclo / Parclo two quadrants / Diamond, every Layout x Scale Small / Medium / Large x highway x level x 2 cross roads x both traffic sides x 1969/2020 at the builder's 0 degree transform, Ramp / Arm length extremes at Scale Large, rotations 90 / 180 (1224 calls, ~20-60 s); p7_presets = the released entries' button presets (main radius 10-60 m, interchange 15-45 m, Channelized Junction, Magic) at 0 degrees, both traffic sides (88 calls, ~5 s). Phase 7e2: p7_hx_scale_verify = the 190 Scale Large parclos p7_hx_scale refused, now within the reach cap, + 30 capped / unprobed (220 calls, ~10 s). Phase 8: p8_bridge = the DEV Bridge probe entries, Probe structure (embankment / bridge / no align / both) x islands keep / drop x 0 / 2 / 4 / 8 / 12 m above the terrain x context none / full: roundabout XS / M, T / 4 arms, Town small / Country medium (640 calls), Roundabout Interchange ring / highway over (160 calls), ~20-40 s. plans/square_roundabouts/PROBE.md

params.name: Start delay
params.tooltip: Seconds after the game has loaded before the probe starts

params.name: Combos per update
params.tooltip: Combinations evaluated per GUI update. Higher is faster but stutters more.

params.name: Position X (m)
params.tooltip: World x of the probe position (0 = map centre)

params.name: Position Y (m)
params.tooltip: World y of the probe position (0 = map centre)

params.name: Proposal context
params.tooltip: None: makeProposalData(proposal). Player: also pass a Context (player, terrain alignment check, street graph cleanup, gather buildings/fields).

params.name: Log placeable combos
params.tooltip: Off: only combinations that fail are logged (the parser then cannot compute failure rates)

params.name: Position
params.tooltip: Where the probe places: the Position X / Y settings, the camera centre (the point the view looks at) or the mouse's last point on the terrain, read when the probe starts
